name: LivaNova
outlook:
What LivaNova says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue growthLivaNova now expects full-year 2026 revenue to grow between 9% and 10% (versus 8% and 9% prior) on a constant-currency basis.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted diluted earnings per shareAdjusted diluted earnings per share for 2026 is now expected to be in the range of $4.40 to $4.50 (versus $4.30 to $4.40 prior), assuming a share count of approximately 56 million for full-year 2026.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted free cash flowIn 2026, the Company estimates adjusted free cash flow in the range of $140 million to $160 million, consistent with prior guidance.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
